name: browser-relay
description: <用户自制> 浏览器会话：必须用 Chrome 时建议 Web Access，其余优先 Ego Lite。 Use Web Access when Chrome is required. Otherwise prefer Ego Lite for browser work, including parallel work on independent pages.

interface.longDescription: Use Web Access when Chrome is required. Otherwise prefer Ego Lite on a supported host. The guide explains scripted page interaction, screenshot-driven controls, and parallel work on independent Ego Lite pages.
